studies.subject: pi
studies.decoder: endophasia capture proxy (endo-capture.1): top-level request fields other than messages and tools
studies.predicate: which of temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, typical_p, seed, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, repeat_penalty Pi sends to an openai-completions endpoint with no sampling configuration
studies.expected: Pi sends sampling parameters only when something configures them
studies.observed: no sampling field in any recorded request: every request carried exactly model, stream, stream_options {include_usage: true}, store: false and max_completion_tokens: 16384 (the 8 requests of the committed cassette fixtures, the E1 smoke run, and a print-mode probe)
limitations: one Pi release (1.0.1), one provider API (openai-completions), one endpoint (llama.cpp); other APIs or providers may send defaults
the server applies its own defaults when no sampling field is sent; those values are not observed here

studies.subject: pi
studies.decoder: review of the documented configuration surfaces: docs/models.md (models.json model entries, compat), docs/settings.md, docs/custom-provider.md; plus a search of every installed doc for temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, seed, sampling, penalty
studies.predicate: Pi 1.0.1 documents a configuration field (models.json or settings.json) that sets temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p or seed for chat-model requests
studies.expected: a documented field sets chat sampling
studies.observed: no such field is documented. The only documented temperature is the per-request option of llama.cpp classifier models (docs/llama-cpp.md, Classification), which applies to classification, not chat. No seed field is documented.
limitations: a documentation review: an undocumented field may exist, and is out of scope by rule (documented surfaces only)
docs as installed with Pi 1.0.1 (digests above)

studies.subject: pi
studies.decoder: a five-line extension in the scratch agent directory (extensions/), handling before_provider_request as Pi documents it in examples/extensions/provider-payload.ts (the custom-provider.md onPayload contract), observed through the pass-through capture proxy
studies.predicate: a documented Pi extension event can set temperature and seed on chat-model requests
studies.expected: the request Pi sends carries the extension’s temperature and seed
studies.observed: with the extension returning { ...event.payload, temperature: 0, seed: 42 }, Pi sent model, stream, stream_options, store, max_completion_tokens, temperature: 0 and seed: 42; without it, none of the sampling fields. The proxy changed nothing.
limitations: the event name before_provider_request appears in a shipped, documented example rather than in the extensions.md prose
an extension is code that Pi loads from its agent directory, not a configuration field
observed once, in print mode, on one Pi release and one endpoint; whether the server honours temperature and seed is a property of the server, not of Pi
